summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Toyer Hair full-business site (Phase 1). Backend: 47/47 pytest tests pass (public catalog, appointments incl. reschedule/deposit/cancel, customer auth + my/*, favorites, admin CRUD + role gating, Stripe CAD checkout with coupon, SEO robots/sitemap). Frontend: all critical flows verified end-to-end on the live preview URL — home, services (24 links), pricing (CAD), shop (16 products visible, filter Wigs -> 3 items, add-to-cart increments nav cart-count), product detail, cart -> Stripe redirect (CA$374.00), booking (service select -> future date -> live slot -> full form -> confirmation w/ manage-link), appointment page (pay-deposit Stripe redirect + cancel), customer register/login/logout/re-login + /account tabs, /account unauth redirect to /login, customer -> /admin redirect to /admin/login, admin login + all 7 tabs (overview, appointments, orders, products, customers, reviews, newsletter) with 8 stat cards, contact form, review submit, newsletter, FAQ (8 items), gallery (16 imgs + 11 filters), nav Services/Shop dropdowns, floating actions. Previous CRITICAL shop opacity=0 bug (iteration 1) is FIXED: Reveal.jsx now uses useInView + animate instead of whileInView.

issues: Page title stays as global default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — Appointment.jsx does not call useSEO(). Minor SEO gap; every other page sets a proper title.

action_items: OPTIONAL (SEO polish): add useSEO({title:'Manage Appointment', path:'/appointment'}) to /app/frontend/src/pages/Appointment.jsx so the browser tab and og:title reflect the page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py appointment insert is still not atomic — read+write race under high concurrency. Add unique compound index on (date, time) filtered by status='booked' before prod launch (Mongo partial index).
server.py: create_checkout re-instantiates StripeCheckout on every call — fine but consider caching the client (module-level) for perf.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' in backend/.env with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid for prod (browsers reject credentialed CORS with *). Fine for preview; restrict origins before deploy.
seed_admin idempotency is good: startup updates password_hash if admin password changed. Verified by successful login with ToyerAdmin2026.
Reveal.jsx fix (useInView + animate) is correct and resolves the framer-motion + Lenis interaction bug from iteration 1.
Booking.jsx polls /availability every 15s while page open — acceptable; could pause when tab hidden (document.visibilityState).

server.py availability endpoint returns 10 slots (09:00..18:00 inclusive) matching BUSINESS_HOURS list — request statement said 9 slots (09-18) but implementation includes 18:00 as bookable which is fine and internally consistent.
